import copy,json
from work import evaluate
cases=[
({"declared":["b","a","a","ignored"],"saved":{"a":{"kind":"file","meta":{"x":1,"y":2}},"b":{"kind":"file","hash":"old"},"ignored":1,"extra":0},"current":{"a":{"meta":{"y":2,"x":1},"kind":"file"},"b":{"kind":"file","hash":"new"},"ignored":2,"extra":9}}, {"ignored":["ignored"]}, {"needs_review":True,"changed":["b"]}),
({"declared":["x"],"saved":{},"current":{"x":{"kind":"missing"}}}, {}, {"needs_review":False,"changed":[]}),
({"declared":["x"],"saved":{"x":{"kind":"file","name":"same","timestamp":1}},"current":{"x":{"kind":"file","name":"same","timestamp":2}}}, {}, {"needs_review":True,"changed":["x"]})]
for req,pol,want in cases:
 before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert (req,pol)==before; assert set(got)=={"needs_review","changed"}
requests=json.load(open("requests.json")); policy=json.load(open("policy.json")); report=json.load(open("report.json")); assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
print("all checks passed")
